catalyst_rows.raw_text: Belite Bio Initiates Rolling Submission of New Drug Application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for Tinlarebant for the Treatment of Stargardt Disease. Belite expects to complete the new drug application submission in the second quarter of 2026. Rolling submission initiated under Breakthrough Therapy Designation.

catalyst_rows.indication: Stargardt disease type 1 (STGD1) - DRAGON II trial
catalyst_rows.raw_text: DRAGON II Trial: Combination of a Phase 1b open-label trial ... and a Phase 2/3 ... Targeted enrollment of 60 subjects was reached in January 2026.

catalyst_rows.indication: Geographic atrophy in advanced dry AMD (PHOENIX trial)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Belite Bio's lead candidate, tinlarebant ... is currently being evaluated in a Phase 2/3 trial (DRAGON II) in adolescent STGD1 subjects and a Phase 3 trial (PHOENIX) in subjects with GA.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: April 21, 2026 NDA rolling submission initiation and Q2 2026 expected completion are fresh 2026 regulatory events post-dating 2024 20-F. DRAGON II enrollment complete (January 2026) and ongoing PHOENIX GA Phase 3 also captured.
